controles.affirmation: CA 2025 +36,6% a 15 048 M CHF ; a perimetre comparable -2,0% ; ajuste et a change constant -1,3%
controles.verbatim_source: CP FY2025 : "the Swisscom Group increased its revenue by 36.6% to CHF 15,048 million" ; "In this comparison, group revenue for 2025 fell by 2.0% year-on-year to CHF 15,048 million... On an adjusted basis and at constant exchange rates, the decline in revenue was 1.3%"

controles.affirmation: Benefice net 2025 -17,6% a 1 270 M CHF, charges d'acquisition Vodafone Italia principal contributeur
controles.verbatim_source: CP FY2025 : "Net income fell by 17.6% year-on-year to CHF 1,270 million. Expenses associated with the acquisition of Vodafone Italia were the main contributors to this decline." (2024 : 1,541)

controles.affirmation: Dividende +18% a 26 CHF pour 2025, 27 CHF pour 2026 si objectifs atteints ; BPA ~24,5 CHF sur 51,802 millions d'actions, donc dividende superieur au benefice par action
controles.verbatim_source: CP FY2025 : "Proposal: Dividend increase of 18% to CHF 26 per share for the 2025 financial year" ; "Swisscom plans to increase the dividend to CHF 27 per share, payable in 2027 for the 2026 financial year". URD FY2025 : "Shares issued thousand 51,802" et "Earnings per share (in CHF) 24.54 29.77 (5.23) -17.6%" — le BPA publie par Swisscom est de 24,54 CHF, ce qui confirme le calcul de l'ATT.
controles.correction_proposee: Rien a corriger. Suggestion : citer directement le BPA publie de 24,54 CHF plutot que le presenter comme un calcul de l'ATT, c'est plus solide.

controles.affirmation: S1 2026 : CA publie -3,0% a 7 221 M CHF, recul organique a change constant -2,0% ; benefice net +6,9% a 668 M CHF (625 M CHF au S1 2025) ; T1 2026 -9,6%
controles.verbatim_source: CP Q2-2026 : "Group revenue decreased by 3.0% year-on-year in the first half of 2026 to CHF 7,221 million... On an adjusted basis and at constant exchange rates, revenue declined by 2.0%" ; "Net income increased year-on-year by 6.9% to CHF 668 million" ; tableau : Net income 668 / 625. CP Q1-2026 : "Net income fell year-on-year by 9.6% to CHF 332 million"

controles.affirmation: "Dette nette alourdie et capitaux propres reduits" : dette nette 15 935 M CHF (-3,6%), capitaux propres -6,3% a 11 516 M CHF "contre 12 238 M CHF un an plus tot" ; "un an plus tot, la dette nette etait de 15 633 M CHF"
controles.verbatim_source: Interim Report H1 2026, tableau "KPIs Group, In CHF million, H1 2026 / H1 2025 / Change / in %" : "Net income 668 625 43 6.9% | Equity 11,516 11,593 (78) -0.7% | Net debt 15,935 16,529 (595) -3.6%". Les valeurs 12,238 et 15,633 existent bien dans le rapport mais ce sont les comparatifs de BILAN au 31.12.2025 : "Total equity 11,516 12,238" et "Net debt 15,935 15,633".
controles.correction_proposee: Trois erreurs cumulees. (1) Le -6,3% des capitaux propres n'existe nulle part : sur douze mois le recul est de -0,7% (11 516 vs 11 593), sur six mois de -5,9% (11 516 vs 12 238). (2) 12 238 et 15 633 ne sont pas des chiffres "un an plus tot" mais du 31 decembre 2025. (3) Les deux bases sont melangees : le -3,6% est la variation sur douze mois (contre 16 529), alors que 15 633 est la base fin 2025 — sur laquelle la dette nette AUGMENTE de 1,9%. Le titre "Dette nette alourdie" contredit le -3,6% cite dans le corps du meme paragraphe. Choisir une seule base et l'annoncer.

controles.affirmation: "Le chiffre d'affaires Italie recule de 4,2% au premier semestre 2026"
controles.verbatim_source: Interim Report H1 2026, tableau segments : "Italy 3,190 3,380 (190) -5.6%" (S1 2026 vs S1 2025, en CHF). CP Q2-2026 : "revenue in the Italy segment decreased by 3.3% to EUR 3,474 million" (en EUR). Le -4,2% est la variation du SEUL T2 2026 en CHF (kpis-haut IT_REV_Q : 1 594 vs 1 663 au T2 2025). La seule occurrence de "4.2%" dans le rapport interimaire est le +4,2% d'EBITDAaL ajuste.
controles.correction_proposee: Le -4,2% est un chiffre trimestriel, pas semestriel. Ecrire : "le chiffre d'affaires Italie recule de 5,6% au premier semestre 2026 en CHF (-3,3% en EUR, a 3 474 M EUR), et de 4,2% sur le seul T2 2026 en CHF, a 1 594 M CHF".

controles.affirmation: Italie 2025 a perimetre comparable : -1,1% a 7 291 M EUR ; 95 M EUR de synergies realisees en 2025
controles.verbatim_source: CP FY2025 : "Compared with the pro forma figures for the year 2024, revenue in the Italy segment fell slightly by 1.1% to EUR 7,291 million." ; "the first synergy effects of EUR 95 million have been realized"

controles.affirmation: Citation : "aggressive promotional campaigns... could affect their revenue growth forecasts" (URD FY2025)
controles.verbatim_source: URD FY2025, deux passages distincts : "aggressive promotional campaigns by operators and service providers without their own networks, potentially impacting revenue" et, ailleurs, "...pose challenges for companies like Fastweb + Vodafone, which could affect their revenue growth forecasts".
controles.correction_proposee: Les points de suspension soudent deux phrases distinctes du chapitre risques en une citation unique. Citer separement : "aggressive promotional campaigns by operators and service providers without their own networks, potentially impacting revenue". Le fond de l'argument reste exact.

controles.affirmation: Telecom suisse : -2,3% a 5 148 M CHF en 2025, economies de couts compensant environ la moitie de l'impact ; -2,1% a 2 529 M CHF au S1 2026 ; 14 764 ETP suisses (-5,4%) ; IT +2,0% en 2025
controles.verbatim_source: CP FY2025 : "Revenue from telecom services fell by 2.3% to CHF 5,148 million. Thanks to improved efficiency and consistent cost savings, the consequences of this decline in revenue was offset by almost half. At the same time, revenue from IT services for business customers increased by 2.0% to CHF 1,215 million." CP Q2-2026 : "Revenue from telecommunications services decreased by 2.1% to CHF 2,529 million" ; "Of which employees in Switzerland (FTE) 14,764 15,612 -5.4%"
controles.correction_proposee: Exact. A signaler toutefois : au S1 2026 le groupe indique "more than half of the impact... was offset", donc la formule "n'ont compense qu'environ la moitie" ne vaut que pour l'exercice 2025.

controles.affirmation: La Confederation suisse detient 51% du capital et des droits de vote et la loi l'oblige a garder la majorite
controles.verbatim_source: URD FY2025 : "The Swiss Confederation holds 51% of the issued share capital of Swisscom Ltd. Under the Telecommunications Enterprise Act (TEA), the Confederation is required to hold the majority of the share [capital]" ; "the Swiss Confederation, which is obligated by current law to hold the majority of the capital and voting rights" ; "the Swiss Confederation, as majority shareholder, continued to hold 51.0% of the issued shares of Swisscom Ltd as in the prior year"

controles.affirmation: CA T2 2026 de 3 615 M CHF, "-2,0% sur un an, publie et a change constant"
controles.verbatim_source: Facts & Figures Q2-2026 : "Revenue 3'759 3'687 7'446 3'730 11'175 3'873 15'048 3'606 3'615 7'221" — T2 2026 3'615 vs T2 2025 3'687, soit -2,0% en publie. Aucun taux a change constant n'est publie pour le seul T2 ; sur le semestre l'ecart est significatif (-3,0% publie contre -2,0% a change constant, l'effet de change s'elevant a 78 M CHF).
controles.correction_proposee: Supprimer "et a change constant" : seule la variation publiee de -2,0% est documentee pour le T2 2026 isole.

controles.affirmation: Objectifs 2026 : 14,7-14,9 Mds CHF de CA et levier (dette nette incluant les baux/EBITDA) d'environ 2,3x fin 2026 ; OpFCF 2025 de 1 920 M CHF (+9,6%)
controles.verbatim_source: CP Q2-2026 : "Swisscom expects revenue of CHF 14.7-14.9 billion, EBITDAaL of CHF 5.0-5.1 billion... and leverage (net debt including lease liabilities/EBITDA) of around 2.3x as of the end of 2026" ; CP FY2025 : "operating free cash flow rose by 9.6% to CHF 1,920 million"
